title: Review recorded by ways review (from the reviewer process), the ways-reviewer subagent hook, or a human with ways review submit <file>

reviewer.description: who reviewed (a label; independence comes from the provenance ways records, not from this name); must not be an author or committer of the increment

commit.description: the evaluated commit printed by `ways done`

severity.description: critical and high block until fixed; medium and low are recorded and shown but never block

disposition.description: only fixed clears a critical or high finding; absent reads as open

accepts.description: changed existing tests or check files (or tests-ran) the reviewer inspected and accepts as legitimate
